origin.description: Tau-score rank test. The score is the dual minus one minus tau. Other scores need the quantile process.
origin.details: Tau-score rank test. The score is the dual minus one minus tau. Other scores need the quantile process.
origin.value: rq.test.rank of two slopes on an intercept, score tau, iid and nid
origin.example:
a <- rq.test.rank(X[,1,drop=FALSE], X[,2:3], y, score="tau", tau=0.5)
b <- rq.test.rank(X[,1,drop=FALSE], X[,2:3], y, score="tau", tau=0.5, iid=FALSE)
c(a$Tn, a$ndf, a$ddf, a$pvalue, b$Tn, b$pvalue)

translation.description: Tau-score rank test. The score is the dual minus one minus tau. Other scores need the quantile process.
translation.details: Tau-score rank test. The score is the dual minus one minus tau. Other scores need the quantile process.
translation.value: rq.test.rank of two slopes on an intercept, score tau, iid and nid
translation.example:
from quantreg import rq_test_rank
a = rq_test_rank(X[:, :1], X[:, 1:], y, score="tau")
b = rq_test_rank(X[:, :1], X[:, 1:], y, score="tau", iid=False)
return [a["Tn"], a["ndf"], a["ddf"], a["pvalue"], b["Tn"], b["pvalue"]]
